此入口未提供完整的标准定仓字段。.en: This entry path did not expose all standard sizing fields.

此报告未记录该订单的定仓过程。重新回测可采集；不以最终余额反推历史。.zh: 此报告未记录该订单的定仓过程。重新回测可采集；不以最终余额反推历史。
此报告未记录该订单的定仓过程。重新回测可采集；不以最终余额反推历史。.en: This report did not record this order’s sizing process. Rerun the backtest to collect it; final balances are not used to reconstruct history.

资金为定仓调用时快照。基础目标、风控与精度处理后的定仓返回值、订单实际输入可能不.zh: 资金为定仓调用时快照。基础目标、风控与精度处理后的定仓返回值、订单实际输入可能不同。取整前数量按当时名义本金、价格和乘数复算；生成及提交数量直接观察真实订单。一订单多笔成交 共用此快照，实际手续费仅属于本笔成交。参考手续费不是预留凭据，不从历史余额重复扣除。
资金为定仓调用时快照。基础目标、风控与精度处理后的定仓返回值、订单实际输入可能不.en: Balances are observed at the sizing call. The base target, post-limit sizing result and actual order input may differ. Pre-rounding quantity is derived from those notional, price and multiplier inputs; created and submitted quantities are observed from real orders. Partial fills share the order snapshot, while each actual fee belongs only to its fill. A reference fee is not evidence of a reserve or another debit.

进场 Fill 可展开“定仓明细”核对当时资金、目标名义本金、数量取整和费用。一.zh: 进场成交 可展开“定仓明细”核对当时资金、目标名义本金、数量取整和费用。一订单多笔成交共享订单快照，各笔手续费分别记录；旧报告缺项显示未记录。
进场 Fill 可展开“定仓明细”核对当时资金、目标名义本金、数量取整和费用。一.en: Expand Entry sizing details on an entry fill to inspect balances, target notional, quantity rounding and fees. Partial fills share an order snapshot and retain separate commissions. Missing observations in older reports are marked Not recorded.

以上为整个回测区间的引擎统计，不随品种、图层、可见 K 线或成交筛选变化。净已实.zh: 以上为整个回测区间的引擎统计，不随品种、图层、可见 K 线或成交筛选变化。净已实现盈亏包含引擎记录的手续费；收益率基于起始资金，不是单笔平仓收益率。余额不含未平仓仓位的未实现盈亏，不能当作期末总权益。最大回撤基于引擎的每日收益序列，夏普比率使用 252 日口径；胜率以引擎的仓位记录统计，不按成交笔数计算。
以上为整个回测区间的引擎统计，不随品种、图层、可见 K 线或成交筛选变化。净已实.en: These are full-period engine statistics, independent of instrument, layer, candle range and fill filters. Net realized P&L includes engine-recorded commissions; return uses starting capital rather than an individual closing fill. Balances exclude unrealized P&L and are not ending equity. Drawdown uses the engine’s daily return series; Sharpe uses 252 days. Win rate uses engine position records, not fill counts.

只显示本次实际导出的统计；未提供的值不估算。资金费、滑点等成本是否计入取决于本次.zh: 只显示本次实际导出的统计；未提供的值不估算。资金费、滑点等成本是否计入取决于本次引擎配置，不能由图表推断。原始精度和全部统计保留在 JSON 下载中。
只显示本次实际导出的统计；未提供的值不估算。资金费、滑点等成本是否计入取决于本次.en: Only exported statistics are shown; missing values are not estimated. Funding, slippage and other costs depend on engine configuration and cannot be inferred from the chart. Original precision and all statistics remain in the JSON download.

Candle timing rules.zh: K线时间为UTC收盘时间。信号按观察时间记录，成交按执行时间记录。标记只能向后对齐到不早于事件的收盘时刻，不回填到拐点。原始时间与价格保留在事件表中。信号在K线上方，成交在下方；计数标记仅作显示聚合。
Candle timing rules.en: Candle timestamps are closes in UTC. Signals use observation time and fills use execution time. Markers align forward to a candle close, never backward to a pivot. Original times and prices remain in the event table. Signals appear above candles, fills below; count markers only group events for display.

Click a SIG or FILL label to highlight i.zh: 点击信号或成交标记可高亮下方记录。拥挤的标记会合并计数，展开已选事件可查看单条记录。点击K线，或聚焦图表后使用左右方向键查看事件。
Click a SIG or FILL label to highlight i.en: Click a SIG or FILL label to highlight its records below. Crowded labels combine into a count; expand the selection to choose an individual event. Click a candle, or use Left and Right with chart focus, to inspect its events.

Use the arrow beside a signal number to.zh: 点击信号编号左侧箭头展开成交。表格只显示数字编号，图表中的成交1.2表示信号1下的第2笔成交。成交前后仓位为带正负号的净数量。未记录的订单类型显示未知，不作猜测；信号或任一成交可见时保留整组。
Use the arrow beside a signal number to.en: Use the arrow beside a signal number to expand its fills. Table numbers omit prefixes: chart FILL1.2 is fill 2 under signal 1. Position before and after are signed net quantities. Unknown order types were not recorded; they are never inferred. A group remains visible if its signal or any fill is in view.

EL = enter long · XL = exit long · ES =.zh: 多开表示开多，多平表示平多，空开表示开空，空平表示平空。信号可以没有成交，一笔成交也可能同时平旧仓并开反向仓。
EL = enter long · XL = exit long · ES =.en: EL = enter long · XL = exit long · ES = enter short · XS = exit short. A signal may have no fill. One fill may close a position and open its opposite.

Realized P&L is this fill's new closing.zh: 本笔已实现净盈亏等于新实现的平仓毛盈亏减去本笔全部手续费。开仓手续费立即扣除一次。累计净盈亏覆盖该品种完整的成交历史，不随筛选或信号分组变化。
Realized P&L is this fill's new closing.en: Realized P&L is this fill's new closing profit or loss minus its entire fee. Opening fees are deducted immediately, once. Cumulative P&L covers this instrument's full chronological fill history, independent of filters and signal groups.

Return uses the closed quantity's weight.zh: 平仓收益率以被平数量对应的加权平均开仓名义本金为分母，并扣除分摊开仓费和平仓费。开仓费已计入此前成交净盈亏，不从累计值重复扣除。纯开仓没有平仓收益率。这些数值不含杠杆、未实现盈亏、资金费或转账。经济属性缺失或非零手续费币种不匹配时显示不可用，不假定汇率。
Return uses the closed quantity's weight.en: Return uses the closed quantity's weighted-average entry notional and deducts its allocated entry and exit fees. Entry fees already affected earlier fill P&L and are not deducted twice from cumulative P&L. Pure opening fills have no closing return. Values exclude leverage, unrealized P&L, funding and transfers. Missing economics or nonzero fees in another currency show Unavailable; no exchange rate is assumed.

missing_stat.zh: 本次引擎未导出此统计，不按图表或成交筛选估算。
missing_stat.en: The engine did not export this statistic; it is not estimated from chart or fill filters.

balances.en: Starting balance {start} → ending balance {end} · orders {orders} · position records {positions}{currencyNote}

selection_count.zh: 已选择{count}个事件，请在下方选择单条记录
selection_count.en: {count} selected events; choose an individual record below

outside.zh: · {count}个事件超出K线范围，仅在表格显示

chart_error.zh: 图表不可用。请保留报告旁的资源目录，或下载完整数据复核。
chart_error.en: Chart unavailable. Keep the assets directory beside the report, or inspect the complete data download.

invalid_lang.zh: 不支持语言参数 {value}，已使用报告默认语言。
invalid_lang.en: Unsupported language parameter {value}; using the report default.

crowded.zh: {label}，共{count}个事件，展开后可查看单条记录。
crowded.en: {label}. {count} events; open selection to inspect individual records.

pnl_missing.zh: 本报告未记录盈亏，请重新回测；原始原因见原始记录。
pnl_missing.en: P&L was not exported or is unavailable; rerun the backtest. See the original record for the raw reason.

no_closing.zh: 本笔成交没有平仓数量。
no_closing.en: This fill has no closing quantity.

return_rule.zh: 平仓净额 {net} / 开仓名义本金 {notional} × 100；分摊开仓费 {entryFee}，平仓费 {exitFee}。不含杠杆和未实现盈亏。
return_rule.en: Closed net {net} / entry notional {notional} × 100; allocated entry fee {entryFee}, exit fee {exitFee}. No leverage or unrealized P&L.

realized_rule.zh: 平仓毛盈亏 {gross} 减本笔手续费 {fee}；精确值 {value} {currency}。
realized_rule.en: Gross realized {gross} minus this fill fee {fee}. Exact: {value} {currency}.

cumulative_rule.zh: 此品种完整历史累计，不受表格筛选影响；精确值 {value} {currency}。
cumulative_rule.en: Full-history cumulative for this instrument, unaffected by table filters. Exact: {value} {currency}.

raw_notice.zh: 原始记录的字段名、标识和策略提供的原始名称保留原文。
raw_notice.en: Raw field names, identifiers and strategy-supplied original names are preserved.

Replay shows only candles, indicator obs.zh: 回放仅显示截止时刻已记录的 K 线、指标、信号和成交。确认后才在原拐点位置显示结构连线；虚线候选段可能变化。整体统计和下载仍包含完整回测区间。
Replay shows only candles, indicator obs.en: Replay shows only candles, indicator observations, signals and fills recorded by the cutoff. Confirmed paths use original pivot coordinates only after confirmation; dashed candidate legs can change. Whole-run statistics and downloads still cover the full run.

Signal labels are above the chart and ac.zh: 上方标签表示信号，下方标签表示实际成交。颜色和形状区分交易动作；聚合标签显示数量，单条标签显示记录编号。
Signal labels are above the chart and ac.en: Signal labels are above the chart and actual fill labels below. Colors and shapes identify actions. Group labels show event counts; individual labels show record numbers.

trigger_missing.zh: 此信号未记录触发明细。重新回测可采集；不使用最终指标或成交价格反推历史条件。
trigger_missing.en: Trigger details were not recorded for this signal. Rerun to capture them; final indicators and fill prices are not used to reconstruct past conditions.

trigger_timing.zh: 以上为信号生成时冻结的观察记录。确认收盘价可能与执行参考价、实际成交价不同；定位按信号真实时刻，不前移到候选极值。
trigger_timing.en: These observations were frozen when the signal was generated. The confirming close may differ from the execution reference and actual fill prices. Locate uses the actual signal time, never the earlier candidate extreme.

Select a time range, or use Home and End.zh: 按K线开盘时间定位。图表聚焦后可按 Home、End 跳到两端。
Select a time range, or use Home and End.en: Locate by candle opening time. Focus the chart and press Home or End to move to either end.

All signals are shown from signal 1 by d.zh: 默认从信号1开始显示全部信号，平移图表不会改变列表。手动开启可见范围筛选后，列表才跟随图表；信号编号保持原始身份。
All signals are shown from signal 1 by d.en: All signals are shown from signal 1 by default. Panning does not change the table; enable the visible range filter to follow the chart. Signal identities remain unchanged.

navigation_earliest.zh: 已移动到最早区域：{time}，保留当前时间跨度。
navigation_earliest.en: Moved to the earliest region: {time}, preserving the visible time span.

navigation_latest.zh: 已移动到最新区域：{time}，保留当前时间跨度。
navigation_latest.en: Moved to the latest region: {time}, preserving the visible time span.

navigation_range.zh: 已定位{count}根K线，开盘时间 {start} 至 {end}。

range_invalid.zh: 请输入有效的UTC开始和结束时间。
range_invalid.en: Enter valid UTC start and end times.

range_reversed.zh: 开始时间不能晚于结束时间，请调整后重新定位。
range_reversed.en: Start must not be later than end. Adjust the range and try again.

range_empty.zh: 该时间范围内没有当前可用的K线，请选择已有数据范围。
range_empty.en: No currently available candles fall within this range. Choose a range with recorded data.
